about: Maxolon (metoclopramide), by brand name only, is supplied five times from February to July 2026 to a 71-year-old man.

Motilium (domperidone) 10 mg is supplied four times from 13 January 2026 to 17 March 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, with the direction TWO tablets three times a day, which is 60 mg a day and above the 30 mg limit.

Motilium (domperidone) 10 mg is supplied six times with the direction ONE tablet three times a day to a patient aged 67, which is 30 mg a day: equal to the limit, not above it, and no metoclopramide is supplied.
